description: This file defines a ResumeRepository class that handles CRUD operations for a resumes table in a database, including creating, retrieving, and listing resumes by user.

classes.name: ResumeRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing resume records in the database, providing methods to create, retrieve, and list resumes.

methods.name: int create( self, user_id: int, file_name: str, content_type: str, content_text: Optional[str] = None, storage_path: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Asynchronously inserts a new resume record into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: Optional[dict] get(self, resume_id: int)
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a resume record by its ID.

methods.name: List[dict] list_by_user(self, user_id: int)
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches all resumes associated with a specific user ID, ordered by creation date.
